pick.name: Cloudflare Tunnel (cloudflared)
pick.what: Expose localhost on your own domain
pick.why: Named tunnels on your domain, available on all plans; quick tunnels need no account
pick.free_limits: Quick tunnels: 200 in-flight requests, no SSE, no uptime guarantee, testing only; use named tunnels for anything real (no SSE matters for MCP/streaming tests)
pick.install: brew install cloudflared (macOS) / winget install --id Cloudflare.cloudflared (Windows) / Linux packages from pkg.cloudflare.com; then: cloudflared tunnel --url http://localhost:3000

alts.name: ngrok Free
alts.free_limits: 3 endpoints, 1 GB, 20k requests/mo, interstitial page, no custom domain; Hobbyist $10/mo

alts.name: Tailscale Funnel
alts.free_limits: Personal plan 'only suitable for non-commercial use'; 6 users

decision: Cloudflare Tunnel is free, on your domain and already pairs with the stack. Use a named tunnel (not trycloudflare) when testing SSE/streaming MCP.
